description: This file implements the RustAdapter plugin for WPEFramework, providing initialization, deinitialization, information retrieval, reference counting, invocation handling, activation, deactivation, attachment/detachment, channel management, and utility functions related to the RustAdapter plugin's integration within the framework.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Plugin::RustAdapter
classes.description: Main class implementing the RustAdapter plugin, managing initialization, deinitialization, and communication with the underlying Rust implementation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the RustAdapter plugin based on shell configuration, choosing between local or remote plugin instances based on profile type and configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin instance during shutdown or reload.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for this object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles the invocation of remote procedures, with different signatures depending on version conditions.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin in the current process.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a specified channel, applicable under certain version conditions.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates tokens and methods, conditionally compiled.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes inbound JSON elements or messages.

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Constructs the library path or filename based on input parameters.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token for the plugin using security interface.
